prerequisites.use: source-graph and source-handle handoff shape; E3-B does not depend on wow-context

hard_rules: implementation source is separate from API reference user project runtime and historical authority
one exact sealed externally materialized source snapshot is required
provider branch tag build label repository name and popularity are never authority or universal semantic conditions
build binding ingestion coverage license state and publication eligibility remain independent axes
source roots roles package boundaries and admitted files are explicit reviewed profile inputs
no source repository hook workflow build script generator Lua XML TOC or binary execution
wow-emmy remains the only Lua parser and analyzer
E2-C TOC XML load and fact contracts are reused rather than forked
all source entities belong to an exact blizzard_ui_source generation
source reference project dependency runtime external and historical entities never merge by name path signature or content
reference source bridges require exact compatible endpoints rules evidence and coverage
source calls do not declare public APIs and source absence does not establish API absence
static source never establishes runtime Secret taint combat protected forbidden managed payload readability performance or success
direct source recognizer and bridge assertions use separate producer partitions
wow-graph independently validates all source and bridge proposals
the source publication uses a dedicated ProjectStore Graph namespace and current selector
inactive source generations pass fresh source graph bridge license and store readback validation before CAS activation
a source publication never mutates a user project current record
last known good failed target inactive target and rollback candidate identities never relabel
raw source excerpts facts graphs databases and packaged artifacts each require an exact redistribution decision
unknown conflicting or missing license state never becomes redistributable
incremental reuse requires exact dependency proof and removed source has complete derived state closure
no network arbitrary filesystem process editor client raw SQL model or search capability exists in the library correctness path
missing real source build license probe benchmark or checksum evidence blocks production current and release claims

required_before_first_rust_implementatio: all prerequisite implementation commits and fixture bundle digests
one synthetic and one exact reviewed sealed real Blizzard UI source snapshot content manifest
provider revision build binding root file source license redistribution and security manifests
TOC XML load analyzer adapter recognizer graph bridge store budget canonicalization and error profiles
all source package unit analyzer fact recognizer graph bridge candidate invalidation publication reader recovery and license vectors
all member and bundle SHA-256 values
production_current_claim_additional_requ: complete mandatory source and graph capabilities
resolved exact license state for the intended local current channel
redistributable_release_additional_requi: E7 signing publication contract and explicit user authorization
